content: Get to the train station immediately; catch the earlier train to avoid rush hour.
But I planned for the 6 PM train.
Change your plan—take the 5:15 and arrive before dark.
How much earlier should I leave to catch that one?
Leave in the next 10 minutes so you have time to buy your ticket calmly.
Alright, but I’ll need to pack quickly.
Pack now and focus on essentials—I’ll list them for you.
Perfect, let’s do that and then I’ll head out.
